notes.title: Hidden Secrets
notes.content:
For those wishing to leave no stone unturned in Arcana Manor, there have been rumors of hidden clues in the mansion that lead to secret discoveries.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32405535/03c39cacd931d9ef86b9d6aae382ab6da0c6af58.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Doctor Arcana's Halloween Challenge
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32405535/4e6575efe1343b90820d20ca4dc5d0359a6e65eb.gif[/img]

Do you dare spend Halloween night exploring the shadows of Arcana Manor? If so, dim the lights and play The Cabinets of Doctor Arcana tonight. Begin a new game and type “31” after your player name to verify that you are playing on Halloween night.

Send screenshots of your diploma at the end of the game to Doctor Arcana via email mastermind@doctorarcana.com.  Screenshots must be received before the dawn of November 1st.

All participant’s diplomas will be posted on the Doctor Arcana site, with “congratulatory" comments from the Doctor.
